- Added a background color and colored the circle (blue) instead of default black.
- Shrank the radius slightly (195 vs 200) so the stroke/edge isn't clipped at the viewBox boundary.
- Added `max-width`/`max-height` with `vmin` so it scales down on small screens.
- Added `role="img"` and `aria-label` for accessibility.
